messages:
nisha_sec: Heads-up: contracted pen-test next Tue 08:00-12:00 PT. Need a compact handoff doc: RBAC snapshot, KMS-safe upload, evidence naming, and retest SLAs. Keep perms minimal.

kyle_ops: I'll own the upload path. Plan: presigned POST to a dedicated bucket with default KMS CMK. No KMS rights to assessors. Lifecycle 30 days.

maria_platform: RBAC snapshot: dump role list + inline policies at start time, sha256 the JSON and store in manifests/. Also capture `aws sts get-caller-identity` for any minted creds.

sam_sre: For ephemeral creds use our sts-mint gateway to issue scoped creds limited to `s3:PutObject` on `pt-<id>/*`. Tag the creds with `pt_id` so CloudTrail filters.

kyle_ops: Upload naming: `<pt-id>/<assessor>/<YYYYMMDD_HHMM>_<sha256>.tgz`. Allowed types: tgz, zip, pcap, json. Max single object 8GB, multipart required >100MB.

maria_platform: Audit export snippet: `aws cloudtrail lookup-events --start-time "2026-04-01T06:00:00Z" --end-time "2026-04-01T14:00:00Z" > cloudtrail.json && tar -czf pt-<id>-archive.tgz cloudtrail.json iam-snapshot.json && sha256sum pt-<id>-archive.tgz > pt-<id>-archive.sha256`.

sam_sre: Retest gating: critical -> emergency retest (48h), high -> 72h mitigation window then retest, medium/low -> schedule 7-14 days. Retest requires short verification PR + CI evidence.

security-bot: Created SEC-2026-1991 "PT handoff: RBAC + lockbox + retest rules" (assignee: kyle_ops; due: 2026-04-05).

nisha_sec: Action items: kyle to provision bucket + presign gateway, maria to produce IAM snapshot script, sam to add `pt_id` tagging in sts-mint. Dry-run for mint+upload day before. Ping me if blocked.
